title: Spatially local mini-batching for implicit neural representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.22236v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural surrogates based on implicit neural representations (INRs) are typically trained on mini-batches spread over the whole domain, since a generic INR loses accuracy when every point of a batch lies in one small region. We show that low-rank neural representations (LRNRs), INRs whose weight matrices are products of shared bases with coefficients emitted by a small hypernetwork, can be trained with spatially local mini-batches. Each step uses the points of one time snapshot of an adaptive-mesh numerical solution inside one small cell, with snapshots and cells drawn according to the refinement of the mesh. We posit that such training is enabled by the structural property of LRNRs, as a local step reaches the shared bases only through the $r$ coefficients of each layer, and keeps one cell from rewriting the network. translated_title: 面向隐式神经表示的空间局部小批量训练
translated_abstract: 基于隐式神经表示（INR）的神经代理模型通常采用分布在整个计算域上的小批量数据进行训练，因为对于一般的INR而言，当一个批次中的所有点都位于某个小区域内时，其精度会显著下降。我们证明，低秩神经表示（LRNR）——一种其权重矩阵是由小型超网络生成的系数与共享基相乘所构成的INR——可以使用空间局部的小批量数据进行训练。每一步训练使用自适应网格数值解某一时间快照中位于单个小单元内的点，快照和单元按照网格的加密程度进行抽取。我们认为，这种训练方式得益于LRNR的结构特性：局部更新仅通过每层的 $r$ 个系数作用于共享基，从而避免单个单元重写整个网络。通过Kolmogorov宽度论证，我们证明当限制在小单元内时，LRNR的隐藏状态接近于一个低（维子空间）……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明低秩神经表示（LRNR）凭借其“局部更新仅通过每层少量系数作用于共享基”的结构特性，可以使用自适应网格单个单元内的点进行空间局部小批量训练，突破了传统INR必须在全域上采样训练的限制，并以Kolmogorov宽度论证提供了理论支持。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that low-rank neural representations (LRNRs) can be trained with spatially local mini-batches—using points from a single small cell of an adaptive mesh at each step—because their structure allows local updates to reach the shared bases only through a few coefficients, a property further supported by a Kolmogorov-width argument.
